purpose: Train a low-capacity PM from stable public author annotations that identify the next support-function family or longitudinal source relation, while keeping every label-only field physically absent from runtime features, retrieval, actual Rank-1, projection, executor, and generator.
supersession_reason: The frozen P2B control study completed 48/48 calls but proved the four semantic atoms are not operationally independent. No public labels or PM fit were created under the failed instrument.

claim.primary: A low-capacity auditable PM can conditionally open RS and at least one memory resource whose actual Rank-1 source is supported by public author annotations, reducing unnecessary resource injection and deterministic context cost without materially degrading end-to-end support quality or increasing material risk under a fixed stack.
not_claimed: The PM predicts a globally optimal human response.
The PM solves unrestricted semantic understanding.
An annotation-suitable resource guarantees generator use or quality improvement.
A failed learned head may be replaced by a rule and still be called learned.

action_space.joint_policy: qualified per-component probabilities followed by deterministic eligibility, conflict, risk, and cost projection

common.unit: state plus frozen actual Rank-1 component candidate
common.candidate_absent: STRUCTURAL_ABSENT; no semantic label and no PM negative

RS.source: ESConv first nonempty supporter turn after the current seeker turn and its public strategy annotation
RS.AM14: positive only for a frozen explicit current-user closure/fatigue signal plus a bounded closing next supporter response; otherwise negative
RS.unmapped_strategy: negative for the selected card, not a claim that the human response was bad

MS.positive: actual Rank-1 source_session_id is the conv_id of a recursive strict-past ancestor event of at least one event assigned to the current source session
MS.negative: actual Rank-1 exists but its source session is not in that recursive ancestor set

ME.source: the same EvoEmo recursive event ancestry plus typed action-result compiler truth
ME.positive: typed actual Rank-1 ME source session is in the current session's recursive strict-past ancestor set
ME.negative: typed actual Rank-1 ME exists but its source session is not in that set

MP.reason: basic_info alone does not state when a profile fact materially changes the next response; the failed LLM instrument cannot supply that gold
MP.transparent_scope_rule_role: baseline and retrieval eligibility only, never learned-head gold

runtime_and_feature_surface: visible dialogue prefix through current seeker turn
actual Rank-1 typed candidate or card
runtime-valid retrieval observations frozen before labels
forbidden_anywhere_in_pm_x: label, PM prediction, or downstream outcome

learning.model_family: regularized logistic regression or equivalently lower-capacity linear probabilistic classifier
learning.features: runtime-only text/vector similarity, candidate/card identity, chronology, availability, selection score and margin; no label-only field
learning.split: ESConv official train/development/test by raw dialogue; EvoEmo six connected-owner outer folds with p13/p18 bound
learning.threshold_selection: development only, once; never changed after held-out results
learning.primary: RS and at least one of MS or ME must pass because MP begins fixed OFF

responsibility.source_or_label: missing/malformed author annotation or invalid ancestry graph
responsibility.retrieval: actual Rank-1 absent, wrong owner, not strict past, invalid typed candidate, or wrong frozen identity
responsibility.PM: valid runtime feature row and stable label exist, but grouped held-out prediction is wrong
responsibility.projection: head prediction is correct but deterministic joint action violates frozen eligibility/conflict/cost rules
responsibility.executor_generator: requested valid resource is not materially used, is misused, or creates material risk
responsibility.measurement: final quality/risk/function evaluator is unreliable or unresolved
responsibility.system: end-to-end learned policy misses noninferiority/risk/cost claims

final_system_measurement.quality: independent end-to-end noninferiority guardrail; never a PM label
final_system_measurement.material_risk: absolute event families measured independently and not offset by quality or cost
final_system_measurement.function: requested candidate contribution and exact component minimum realized
final_system_measurement.cost: deterministic injected context plus provider tokens, latency, and USD reported separately
final_system_measurement.generator_integration: resource content is absorbed through the frozen typed adapter before response generation; simple post-hoc retrieval concatenation is forbidden

external_tracks.ESConv: RS training/development/test and same-stack response experiment
external_tracks.EvoEmo: longitudinal MS/ME cross-fitted routing and end-to-end response experiment
external_tracks.ES_MemEval: QA transport and memory retrieval diagnostic only; QA gold never trains response PM

no_loop_rules: Do not return to LLM-created four-axis gold.
Do not use future supporter or event-graph fields as PM features.
Do not change the annotation mapping after any fitted or held-out result.
Do not append synthetic users or small rescue packets after a failed head.
Do not lower the head floor after results.
Do not call the annotation oracle a deployable baseline.
